canonical_schedule_rule: All policy/evaluator exogenous fields listed in frozen history registry; omit id and unused synthetic packet placeholders/identities.
chronology: All five original TRAIN/VAL solver and gate records frozen before TEST world generation; then all320 worlds generated and content-audited before any TEST policy or Oracle scoring.
claims_scope: Approximate optimum of this fixed-feature regularized convex logit problem only. No global NDU or task-optimality inference from objective optimum.
cost_scope: Report shared TRAIN features/Gram/spectrum,each solver,validation/test,and full process endpoints. No new full-model-training comparison or task-quality speed claim.

direct_solver.independent_check: Cholesky solution of same linear system and reference-H gradient; numerical checks only
direct_solver.method: eigh of A=H.T*H/n+lambdaI; solve(A+muI)delta=g with scalar monotone root if active; fixed160 maximum bisections and64 bracket steps

duplicate_policy: Compare all320 actual schedule fingerprints to frozen known-history and each other before any TEST score; any duplicate or registered integer seed collision blocks whole run, no resampling or seed change.
exact_original_budget: sum Fraction(stored_b[j])-Fraction(b0[j]) squared <= sum Fraction(b0[j]) squared /4
exact_safe_budget: actual stored real squared difference <= Fraction(binary64 safe_radius)**2

final_storage_numerical_inward_guard.condition: Only if stored actual exact safe radius is exceeded after floating root/projection/storage; recompute diagnostics and fail if still outside; identical routine for D/G; no target/value selection.

fit_data: All and only original TRAIN rows from each pinned checkpoint input; rebuild strict hidden+bias H and own model bank7. No old TEST probes or teacher posterior in fitting.
gap: grad_f(b).dot(b-b0)+rho_safe*norm(grad_f(b)); floating diagnostic at stored b, not outward exact real global certificate

history_coverage.known_uncovered: Original formal confirmation world content absent from available archive; unknown/external history not covered; seed definitions alone do not prove content uniqueness.

new_parameter_scope: Only49 Belief row plus bias; W1,core,decoder,three continuation rows unchanged relative to paired A/C. C is old frozen continuation edit, no new fitting of C.
numerics: Original strict explicit-reduction model path; NumPy overflow/invalid/divide raise; model forecast never newly clipped; eig/Cholesky floating linear algebra disclosed.
objective_target: log(p)-log1p(-p), own bank7 only; finite strict0<p<1 required, fail without clipping
parameter_serialization: Build real candidate checkpoint JSON by replacing onlynetwork.w2[3]/b2[3]; roundtrip must reproduce evaluated head exactly; restoring those49 values must equal paired original checkpoint. Record canonical model SHA and head-only export, no full model copies.

projected_gradient.not_converged_policy: Retain candidate/diagnostics and evaluate; prohibit same-convex-precision solver speed ratio if either solver lacks declared tolerance
projected_gradient.stop: own final-stored-b reference-H numerical FW gap <=1e-8, or fixed maximum; no direct-solution information

required_bank_semantics: no-new-observation predictive state probability at next boundary, two boundaries and deadline6; thresholds normalized(-.5,0,.5), strict>; actual scheduled future drives and durations
required_target: sign(X_deadline6)>0, including early submit; learned belief is not privileged posterior
run_policy: One scientific execution, no retry,no hyperparameter tuning. Preserve blocked records if any prerequisite,number,content or budget gate fails.
seed_derivation: SHA256 canonical labelled JSON(namespace,design_sha256,generator_sha256,fit,domain,purpose,replication=0), entire256-bit digest as RNG entropy. Design excludes its own hash,derived seeds,results,and timestamps.
selection: Exactly one direct and one PGD candidate per fit. No VAL lambda/radius/seed selection; evaluate all six raw arms then fixed paired gates.
statistics: Paired five-training-fit descriptive Student-t95% CIs,df4,no multiplicity adjustment; report all raw/gated and D-G/ CD-CG; no global external-unseen claim.
teacher_scope: Oracle labels,posterior,branches and utility only for evaluation, never fit inputs/targets.
